title: Candidate
description: A single retrieved reference prompt shown alongside the reconstruction (FAISS nearest-neighbor result, resolved to its MongoDB document).

id.description: Reference prompt id (MongoDB _id of the reference_prompts document).

source.description: Reference dataset the candidate was drawn from, e.g. 'diffusiondb', 'alpaca'.

similarity.description: Cosine similarity between the input embedding and this candidate's embedding, in [0, 1].

structured_fields.description: Weak-labeled structured fields for this candidate, if available.

thumbnail_url.description: URL to a thumbnail of the candidate's source image, if the candidate came from the image pipeline.
